svg.title: StarRocks Local OLAP Integration Boundary
svg.desc: Architecture diagram for exposed-starrocks showing Exposed-facing APIs, StarRocks adapter classes, Connector/J boundary, and the local StarRocks all-in-one service scope.
svg.text: A narrow Connector/J smoke path for Exposed, not a broad StarRocks DDL or cloud feature layer.
Reader contract: exposed-starrocks proves a local Connector/J smoke path; broad StarRocks DDL, stream load, external catalogs, and cloud behavior remain out of scope.
